target_module: origins/party/join.ts (proposed, not checked against the repo)

data_fields.name: size_cap_vs_leader_level
data_fields.donor_constant: members + 1 must not exceed leader level (hpMax / 100)

best_idea: Run every join gate on the ledger before any roster mutation, and cap party size by the leader's level, so a refused join can never leave a half-changed roster.
decision_why: Keep the gate-then-swap order and the size cap by leader level for a future co-op group; reject the karma band, which is Ultima IV virtue design with no Frankendom counterpart.
acceptance: A server test where a level-2 leader accepts one companion, refuses a third with the size-cap result, and the roster and emitted-event count are unchanged after the refused join.
